title: Scientists discover a hidden switch that burns fat and blocks new fat cells
caption:
Scientists have identified a protein called Mitch that acts like a metabolic switch. By disabling it in lab tests, cells increased fat burning and blocked the development of new fat cells.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a hidden switch that burns fat and blocks new fat cells
